title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Watermelon Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Watermelon Flavour Concentrate offers a refreshing twist on the classic Pinkman profile. This concentrate combines the established base of sweet Red Berries—featuring prominent Strawberry and Raspberry notes balanced by zesty Citrus hints—with the crisp, clean taste of Watermelon. The addition of Watermelon adds a lighter, refreshing dimension to the mix, smoothing out the sharp citrus undertones while enhancing the fruitiness of the berry blend. It creates a balanced profile that is sweet without being heavy. This 30ml bottle contains 100% PG-suspended flavour concentrate and is not ready to vape directly. It requires dilution with a VG/PG base mix and nicotine shots if desired. Vampire Vape recommends a mix ratio of 15-20% depending on preference. Ideal for DIY enthusiasts, it allows for precise control over flavour strength and vapour production. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
